mass_estimate.basis: Complete installed one-cell estimate. Sum independent low/high allowances without rounding; these are not confidence intervals. Exclude tools, charger, spares, retail stock and removed print supports. Physical mass is unmeasured.

balance.basis: Uniform CAD-part and declared stock mass-centre model. Numeric ranges vary mass allowances at fixed specified positions; they do not bound supplied component mass distribution, infill asymmetry, placement error, strap twist, walking or physical wearing angle. Necklace mass enters worn mass, not pendant CG. Physical balance is unmeasured.

dimensions_mm.scope: Fitted closed CAD products including textile attachment targets; free neck span has no fixed rigid envelope

source_status: Source nominal geometry and specified fabrication targets; supplied tolerances and physical qualification remain unmeasured

service_clearance.basis: Conservative continuous nominal CAD bounding box: closed assembly, released door and keeper sweeps, full cell withdrawal and specified finger approaches. This is not a supplied tolerance or full human-hand bound; physical access remains unmeasured.

dimension_drawing.dimension_basis: Actual curve-and-tolerance source bounds; mesh silhouettes are illustration only
